title: 20th Day
categoryChain: Everyday short duas in the month of Ramadhan

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِيْ فِيْهِ اَبْوَابَ الْجِنَانِ،
verses.translation: O Allah, on this day, (please) open for me the gates of the gardens of Paradise,
shut in my face the gates of Hellfire,
and lead me to recite the Qur'an.

verses.arabic: يَا مُنْزِلَ السَّكِيْنَةِ فِى قُلُوْبِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ۔
verses.translation: 0 He Who sends down tranquility on the hearts of the believers!
